speaker: Doctor
text: I see you are pregnant and experiencing fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. To begin our evaluation, have you noticed any rash or stiff neck, and when did these symptoms first start?

speaker: Patient
text: 22-year-old female at 30 weeks gestation. The patient presents with a sudden onset of fever, headache, anorexia, fatigue, and malaise. She reports the consumption of ice cream 3 days prior to the onset of symptoms.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. The history of ice cream consumption is significant; have you noticed any diarrhea, vomiting, or abdominal cramping alongside your fever? Also, have you had any contact with cattle or unpasteurized dairy products other than ice cream?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Fever. I also have Headache, Anorexia, Fatigue, Malaise. A doctor I saw earlier said this was very likely Iron deficiency anemia and told me the presentation was already quite typical.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Unpasteurized dairy product ingestion leading to Listeria monocytogenes infection.
